# Langar One

> Langar One (Langar One Foundation) is a 501(c)(3) charity, EIN 41-3146886, that delivers free groceries to families facing food insecurity across the United States. It is inspired by langar, the Sikh tradition of the free community kitchen. Families pay $0.

Founded in 2021 and based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Approved families receive grocery deliveries for three months, renewable while the need continues. Contact: info@langar.one

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.langar.one/): mission, impact, and ways to get involved
- [How It Works](https://www.langar.one/how-it-works/): the four steps from request to doorstep and what families receive
- [What Is Langar?](https://www.langar.one/what-is-langar/): the tradition Langar One is built on
- [FAQ](https://www.langar.one/faq/): who qualifies, cost, what is delivered, and how long support lasts
- [Partners](https://www.langar.one/partners/): how agencies refer clients at no cost
- [Donate](https://www.langar.one/donate/): sponsor a family's groceries; $170 feeds one family for a month
- [Volunteer](https://www.langar.one/volunteer/): ways to help and the volunteer application
- [Plan an Event](https://www.langar.one/plan-event/): host a food drive, fundraiser, or awareness event
- [Our Founders](https://www.langar.one/founders/): who started Langar One and why
- [Free Groceries](https://www.langar.one/free-groceries/): how to get free groceries delivered to your home
- [For Seniors](https://www.langar.one/seniors/): free grocery delivery for older adults
- [Food Pantry Delivery](https://www.langar.one/food-pantry-alternative/): free grocery delivery for people who cannot get to a food pantry
- [Where We Deliver](https://www.langar.one/locations/): cities served, including Los Angeles and San Francisco
- [Corporate Giving](https://www.langar.one/corporate-giving/): how companies sponsor families and match employee gifts
- [Stories & Updates](https://www.langar.one/stories/): articles on langar, getting free groceries delivered, and helping older adults find food
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.langar.one/privacy/)
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.langar.one/terms/)
